props.title: Invoice line item amounts
props.description: Line-item amounts in minor currency units; matching descriptions are summed.

invoice_number.description: Human readable invoice identifier presented to customers.

status.description: Canonical invoice status after provider mapping.

provider_status.description: Original provider reported status or badge.

issued_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice was finalized or posted.

due_at.description: Payment due timestamp derived from payment terms.

total_minor.description: Total amount due expressed in minor currency units.

balance_minor.description: Remaining amount outstanding in minor units.

payment_terms.description: Payment term label describing when payment is expected.

collection_state.description: Dunning phase or retry program detail presented to success teams.

last_reminder_at.description: Timestamp of most recent payment reminder issued to customer.

aging_bucket_days.description: Number of days outstanding grouped for aging reports.

attempt_count.description: Number of automatic payment attempts made on this invoice (Stripe smart-retries attempt_count). Increments on each retry in the dunning window. Source: docs.stripe.com/billing/revenue-recovery/smart-retries.

next_payment_attempt.description: When the next automatic payment retry is scheduled (Stripe smart-retries next_payment_attempt). Defines the open end of the retry window — modeled on the Refundable.refundable_until datetime-window precedent. Absent/null when no further attempts are scheduled (retries exhausted → invoice goes uncollectible, mirroring the subscription `unpaid` state). Source: docs.stripe.com/billing/revenue-recovery/smart-retries.

memo.description: Internal finance note or customer visible memo.

refundable_until.description: Date when refund eligibility window ends for this record.

refund_policy_url.description: Link to customer facing refund or cancellation policy.

total_refunded_minor.description: Cumulative amount refunded in minor currency units.

credit_memo_balance_minor.description: Remaining credit memo balance that can be applied to invoices.

credit_memo_type.description: Category of credit memo tied to business justification.

last_refund_at.description: Timestamp when the most recent refund was issued.

requires_manager_approval.description: Indicates if finance manager approval is required before issuing refund.

notes.description: Internal commentary about refund actions or policy exceptions.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the entity was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp for the most recent modification, when available.

last_event.description: Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.

last_event_at.description: Timestamp for the lifecycle event captured in last_event.

invoice_id.description: Primary identifier for the invoice inside the billing domain.

subscription_id.description: Subscription identifier this invoice is associated with.

provider_invoice_id.description: Native provider identifier retained for audit trails.

billing_contact_name.description: Customer billing contact receiving the invoice.

billing_contact_email.description: Email address for the billing contact.

tax_minor.description: Tax amount collected on the invoice in minor currency units.

discount_minor.description: Total discounts applied to the invoice in minor units.

subtotal_minor.description: Subtotal before discounts and tax in minor units.

line_items.description: Normalized line items with quantity, amount_minor, and description fields.

attachments.description: Supporting documents or credit memos associated with the invoice.

portal_url.description: Link to the hosted invoice or customer billing portal.

dunning_step.description: Current dunning playbook step label (ex: reminder_1, reminder_final, collections). The structured retry window (attempt_count + next_payment_attempt) is provided by the composed SaaSBillingPayable trait; this field is the human-readable step name.

payment_source.description: Payment method used or expected (card, ach, wire).
